EV Price War: VinFast Slashes VF MPV 7 Price In India By Lakhs

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • Shifting its focus from electric SUVs, VinFast aimed to capture the 7-Seater Electric MPV segment in India with VF MPV 7.
  • The company launched VF MPV 7 on April 15th, 2026 and it went on sale against BYD’s eMax 7.
  • The launch price of VinFast VF MPV 7 was Rs 24.49 lakh in April 2026 and has now got a major price cut.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

Shifting its focus from electric SUVs, VinFast aimed to capture the 7-Seater Electric MPV segment in India with VF MPV 7. The company launched VF MPV 7 on April 15th, 2026 and it went on sale against BYD’s eMax 7. The launch price of VinFast VF MPV 7 was Rs 24.49 lakh in April 2026 and has now got a major price cut.

📌 The Core Development

Fast forwarding to November 2026, VinFast VF MPV 7 now costs just Rs 20.39 lakh (Ex-sh). This is a direct result of a price cut VinFast has introduced for VF MPV 7 in India. This price cut is Rs 4.1 lakh on the Ex-sh price and the same also reflects on VinFast’s official website.

India has always been a price sensitive market and the popular Vietnamese electric mobility solutions provider, VinFast, seems to know this perfectly. If we look at the company’s VF 6 and VF 7 offerings, they were priced quite well and have been selling in decent numbers in the country too.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

When VinFast launched VF MPV 7 in the country, it was priced at Rs 24.49 lakh (Ex-sh) with a tagline – One India, One Price. However, the price may have caused a slump in VF MPV 7 sales and VinFast seems to have realised it and gave it a price cut of Rs 4.1 lakh. This price cut is significant enough to bring VF MPV 7 back in the wishlist of many prospective buyers.

For context, similar 7-seater electric vehicles like Mahindra XEV 9S are currently priced from Rs 20.65 lakh and MG Tomahawk EV starts from Rs 19.49 lakh, both prices Ex-sh. BYD eMax 7, on the other hand, is a direct import and it is priced from Rs 27.9 lakh (Ex-sh).

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

The price cut comes as VF MPV 7 sales remain modest compared with VinFast’s other offerings. During H1 FY2027 (April–September 2026), the electric MPV recorded 520 units, accounting for just 3.91% of VinFast’s total India sales of 13,307 units. The commercial-focused Limo Green led with 7,192 units and a 54.05% share, followed by the VF7 with 3,519 units and VF6 with 2,076 units. The Rs 4.1 lakh reduction could help the VF MPV 7 attract more private buyers and increase its contribution to the company’s sales.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

VinFast is currently India’s 4th best-selling Electric Car manufacturer and we can see in the sales charts that the company sold 2,964 units in the month of September 2026 and was just behind JSW MG Motor, Mahindra Auto and Tata Motors. VinFast has also started its ride-hail cab service in the country, employing a commercial version of VF MPV 7, called Limo Green.

VF MPV 7 is measures 4,740 mm in length and has a 2,840 mm long wheelbase. Exterior design can be defined as minimalist and gets large window area. On the inside, we get two interior theme options and a 10.1-inch screen takes centre stage. There is three-row seating arrangement and can accommodate up to 7 occupants.
